normalization: EPR estimates and differences are divided by the total uncoupled EPR, N sigma_0.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Student intervals across independent complete oscillator systems. The two EPR estimators share trajectories. Changes between runs use independent-sample Welch intervals.
measurement_halves: Late minus early EPR is paired across measurement halves. The halves are duration-weighted within each replica.
exact_benchmark: At k=0 the stationary normalized EPR is one.
